issues.description: Element: WHERE clause in solution_repository/aufgabe05.sql. Problem statement (problem_statement.md line 37) asks for the names of Gemeinden in Oberbayern OR Niederbayern that have a Wanderweg. The solution (solution_repository/aufgabe05.sql) contains a WHERE condition using an impossible conjunction: AND (Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk='Oberbayern' AND Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk='Niederbayern'), which can never be true. This contradicts the problem statement and will return no rows; students implementing the correct OR will get different (and correct) results than the provided solution, causing confusion when comparing against the reference.
issues.suggestedFix: In solution_repository/aufgabe05.sql, change the WHERE condition to use OR between the two regions. Replace AND (Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk='Oberbayern' AND Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk='Niederbayern') with AND (Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk='Oberbayern' OR Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk='Niederbayern') so the solution matches the problem specification.
